description: This PHP source file defines the 'EmailConfigurationAPI' class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing email configuration settings within the OrangeHRM HRM system. The class includes methods for retrieving, updating, and validating email configuration data, as well as sending test emails. It implements endpoint logic, validation rules, and interacts with service and data access objects related to email settings.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationAPI
classes.description: Defines a REST API endpoint for email configuration management, including retrieval, updating, validation, and testing of email settings within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmailConfigurationService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the EmailConfigurationService instance used for email configuration operations.

methods.name: setEmailConfigurationService
methods.description: Sets the EmailConfigurationService instance, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch current email configuration settings, providing default values if none exist.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for fetching email configuration by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update email configuration settings and optionally send a test email.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating email configuration, including conditional rules based on email transport type.

methods.name: getMailTypeDependentRules
methods.description: Determines validation rules that depend on the mail type, authentication type, and existing configuration.

methods.name: getSmtpHostRule
methods.description: Validation rule for SMTP host parameter.

methods.name: getSmtpUsernameRule
methods.description: Validation rule for SMTP username parameter.

methods.name: getSmtpPasswordRule
methods.description: Validation rule for SMTP password parameter.

methods.name: getSmtpAuthTypeRule
methods.description: Validation rule for SMTP authentication type parameter.

methods.name: saveEmailConfigurationInfo
methods.description: Reads request data to update or create an EmailConfiguration entity and persists it.

methods.name: setEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Sets properties of the given EmailConfiguration entity from request parameters.
